blocks.request: Approval of an up to $500,000 loan secured by Senior lien on all business assets.

blocks.text: Dequindre Plastics Molding LLC is a Detroit based business that employs approximately 41 people.
Dequindre Plastics is an injection molder of plastic housings and trim components whose largest customer reduced orders in 2025.
NAICS 326199: All Other Plastics Product Manufacturing.
[Underwriter to complete: customer base / concentration]
[Underwriter to complete: request detail (purpose, structure, fees, guarantees)]
[Underwriter to complete: senior lender / banking relationship]
Frank DeLuca — Owner.
Silent Partner LLC — Investor.
Revenues decreased 5.0%, from $5.600M in FYE 12/31/23 to $5.320M during FYE 12/31/24. Sales then decreased 12.0%, from $5.320M in FYE 12/31/24 to $4.682M during FYE 12/31/25.
Cost of Goods Sold have steadily increased during the periods reviewed (from 83% of sales during FYE 12/31/23, 85% of sales during FYE 12/31/24 to 87% of sales during FYE 12/31/25).
The margins for net income and EBITDA have varied (net income between -8% to -0% of sales, while EBITDA has maintained a margin of between -2% to 5% of sales).
Cash flows were not sufficient to service the obligations of the Borrower in every period. DSCR was 0.69x, 0.29x and -0.18x during FYE 12/31/23, 12/31/24 and 12/31/25, respectively.

Net worth declined from $693,004 to $127,586 over the period. Total liabilities have fluctuated slightly over the periods reviewed and leverage (debt to worth) is increasing (3.19x to 15.86x). Please see Exhibit D - Historical Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth for further detail.

Historical operations have not generated enough cash flow to cover the proposed debt service in every year. For DSCR to reach 1.00x, sales would need to increase 14.4%, 39.7% and 88.5% in FYE 12/31/23, FYE 12/31/24 and FYE 12/31/25, respectively. Our model adjusts the cost of goods sold so that gross profit margins are consistent with historical levels. Operating expenses are treated as a fixed cost and are not adjusted to sales.

NAICS 326199 — All Other Plastics Product Manufacturing (source: document analysis (LLM)). Benchmarked against IRS Statistics of Income tax year 2022 aggregates for 'Plastics product' (Manufacturing; 8,021 corporate returns).
